scores.visual_critic_note: Clean card grid with an intentional Tol bright palette, but 6 of 9 cells appear blank at screenshot time due to staggered animation startup — the technique is largely invisible in the static render.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Bar and area morphs maintain zero baselines and D3's pack layout uses area-correct radius, but domains are hardcoded ([0,1], [0,1.2]) rather than data-driven, and no key functions guard data joins — acceptable for a synthetic animation showcase.
scores.stress_test_note: No user-driven interactions exist so most criteria are N/A, but initStarCircle uses static starPts/circlePts arrays in attrTween closures instead of current element state, and no .interrupt() is called before chaining new transitions in loopMorph.
scores.cognitive_load_note: 9-panel gallery with clear labels and restrained per-cell color use (1–3 hues each, except Scatter↔Bar's 8-color rainbow) reads well as a browse format, but 9 simultaneously looping animations risk visual fatigue and the screenshot shows 5 blank panels suggesting a render-timing fragility that could leave viewers confused.
